quarterly_data.quarter: Uber press release: Pony.ai and Uber Expand Partnership to Deploy Over 2,000 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Pony.ai: Uber and Pony.ai expanded their strategic partnership with plans to collaborate on deploying more than 2,000 Pony.ai Robotaxis across Europe, expanding from the Zagreb service to four additional cities in Europe, with plans to deploy in the Middle East as well. Pony.ai provides its L4 autonomous driving technology; Uber provides customer access (booking, payment and customer service) through its mobility platform; day-to-day fleet operations may be carried out by local fleet partners, and vehicle funding and ownership can sit with different partners depending on the market. Sarfraz Maredia, Uber's Global Head of Autonomous Mobility & Delivery: 'The next chapter for autonomous mobility is about moving from individual launches to repeatable commercial scale.'
quarterly_data.figure: more than 2,000 Pony.ai Robotaxis; four additional cities in Europe
